scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && python3 -m unittest discover -s worker -p 'test_*.py'
